messages:
tanya_sales: Heads-up 11 Prospect 'AuroraLedger' (mid-market payments) sent a security questionnaire and wants a 72h POC. Core asks: SAML SSO, SCIM bulk+delta (target 75k users), RBAC with admin separation and audit trails, domain locking (proof via DNS TXT), EU data residency, and a clear Hosted vs Dedicated cost comparison + an SOW. Can we triage owners?
josh_se: thanks 1 do they want to start Hosted or go straight to Dedicated for latency validation?
tanya_sales: they said they prefer Hosted for initial validation but need a costed path to Dedicated if perf meets requirements. Procurement asked for a 1-page SOW and a short pricing paragraph by EOD.
navi_eng: for Dedicated perf if they expect 75k user sync + 150 TPS gen bursts, recommend a 6-GPU reserved pool with 1.5x burst headroom. Rough committed range: $40k-$90k/mo depending on model family/quantization. Hosted POC for 72h (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) usually < $1.5k in usage; Dedicated is commit-based with SLA.
navi_eng: perf note: prefix KV cache + tuning batching should keep p95 under 250ms for typical 1.5k token sessions; propose quantized variants to reduce cost during POC.
josh_se: SCIM details 1 they need bulk import and delta via PATCH. What temporary SCIM rate bump can we offer?
navi_eng: we can offer a POC rate bump (e.g., 3x standard cap) with advisory backoff guidance. Ask them to confirm expected sync windows.
min_sec: security checklist: request completed questionnaire, IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL, X509 cert), explicit SCIM ops required (create/update/patch/delete), data classification (PII/payment card data?), retention/audit window, and whether HSM-backed keys are mandated. We'll provide SOC2 link, DPA template, pen-test summary, and KMS/HSM options doc. Who will upload to their procurement portal?
contracts_legal: I'll handle DPA countersign once we have their legal POC. Please send contact.
tanya_sales: I'll ask for legal POC, IdP metadata, and a 100-user CSV to start. Also requesting whether they want domain lock validation via TXT or DNS CNAME.
josh_se: SCIM example mapping to send (simple):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "email",
  "name": { "givenName": "firstName", "familyName": "lastName" },
  "emails": [{ "value": "email", "type": "work" }],
  "groups": ["roles"]
}
```
josh_se: POC plan suggestion:
- Day 0: exchange IdP metadata, create tenant, issue SCIM test tokens
- Day 1: run full SCIM import (100 -> 10k sample), validate mappings and RBAC roles
- Day 2: ramp to 50k then 75k import, run SSO end-to-end and audit log verification
- Day 3: perf smoke (ramp to 150 TPS gen bursts), provide latency & cost report, handoff security artifacts
We can compress to 48-72h depending on their readiness. Request 3 test domains and a sample CSV (100 rows) to start.
min_sec: security pack (short blurb) to give procurement: "SOC2 Type II, DPA template available, redacted pen-test summary, EU data residency options (EU regions), default managed KMS; HSM integrations available for enterprise. Audit logs, retention configurable by plan."
tanya_sales: can someone draft the 1-paragraph Hosted vs Dedicated pricing so I can paste into procurement email? Include a small dedicated commit range.
navi_eng: pricing paragraph draft: "Hosted: pay-as-you-go, usage billing ideal for short evaluations and light production. Typical 72h POC (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) commonly < $1.5k. Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and SLAs; for the sizing above (6-GPU cluster supporting 150 TPS bursts) expect committed spend in the ~$40k
$90k/month range depending on model family and quantization; includes SLA, private capacity, and options for extended audit log retention. One-time POC engineering/security support can be covered via pilot credits or invoiced as a professional services line item."
contracts_legal: looks good 1 I'll slot DPA review.
poc_bot: ticket #POC-6212 created: AuroraLedger POC 1 owners: avi_eng (infra), josh_se (integration), min_sec (security), contracts_legal (contracts). Link: https://redwood.internal/poc/POC-6212
tanya_sales: great 1 I'll send initial ask to AuroraLedger: IdP metadata, legal contact, 100-user CSV, confirmation of Hosted vs Dedicated preference (they said Hosted first). Update this thread with replies and I'll coordinate the SOW.
